contracts.record: The first48-byte binding resource is12floats: center then three local axes. The writer transforms center and center+axis endpoints, then subtracts transformed center. Axis evaluation order is offsets6,3,9. Each squared length is float-stored before the root and its reciprocal is float-stored; zero length gives inverse0.
contracts.ring: For each adjacent pair of the shared eight direction-ring rows, project onto each axis using its inverse length. Coefficients are float-stored. Reconstruct offset in axis order3,6,9, float-store it, then add world center and float-store again. These separate stores matter and are absent from the simplified decompiler expression.
contracts.geometry: Always emits eight side quads,32XYZ/color records, using[current,current+direction*5,next+direction*5,next]. VertexCount increases32 and GeneratedValue increases16 (two per edge). The color word comes from separate global2854c00. Unsigned GroupCount<250 adds one start/count8 metadata entry; saturated metadata does not stop geometry.
contracts.parameters: Original fourth/fifth stack parameters are not read by this PC body. Native fixtures pass quietNaN/infinity poison in them while preserving finite active inputs. The consumer's upper/lower values therefore have no effect here. Ring rows are read-only; this writer does not regenerate them.
